purpose: Document separate English/local-language searches, first-party local registry/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry discovery.
assessment: City office directory confirms local housing/land and assessor offices. National Geoportal has General Santos existing land use, not a parcel fabric. An official FOI response previously said the requested cadastral shapefile was not held at central DENR. No anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.
registryAssessment: First-party registry, cadastral or land-administration custodian route identified as described in the cited official-source observations; public safe geometry remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official General Santos city directory lists City Housing and Land Management Office and City Assessor’s Office.
Official Philippine Geoportal lists an Existing Land Use Map for General Santos; that thematic land-use layer is not parcel cadastre.
